The Claude Code desktop app's iOS simulator now supports iPhone Duo and a layout control. 

No excuse not to optimize your app for iPhone Duo anymore. Also, wondering if Android foldables will get the same feature eventually.

"App optimizations" is a good task for AI 👀

Google Labs ❤️ Howie

Howie, a company behind Howie AI secretary, is joining Google Labs. 

The team will help Google building scheduling and calendar management tools for small businesses. https://t.co/8sNlaQzsV0 https://t.co/ML3ZTKXv1s

ElevenLabs ❤️ Kotoba

Kotoba, a voice AI lab from Japan is joining ElevenLabs. Over there, Kotoba voice research will power ElevenAgents to serve customers in Japanese. 

So is it TwelveLabs now? 👀 https://t.co/Dnkp5bwofy https://t.co/enuBrPv9ba

Big day for us: the Superintelligence newsletter just got a full redesign.

I write it every day. I go through all the AI news, keep what matters and explain it in plain words, in about 8 minutes of reading.

Today's issue:

- Qwen4-Max looks frontier-class on Alibaba's own https://t.co/QFNdFkaV9m

Nasiko has launched Open Runtime, an open-source tool that optimizes AI agent spending per task.

Before a long file reaches an AI model, Nasiko trims non-essential parts, reducing token consumption. In Nasiko's server-log-based test, costs per task fell 40% with no drop in https://t.co/dZCAICB53a https://t.co/6sQmckXqQF

Apple has added face unlock to the iPhone Duo in the iOS 27.3 beta, Bloomberg reports.

It uses the front camera and is less secure than Face ID. Touch ID is still required for Apple Pay and passwords.

My Duo will not arrive before January 2027 🥲 https://t.co/0o4SJsJmWH

Joke aside: Why should we still hold meetings in the age of AI agents? My take: within a year, we will replace human meetings with team meetings involving AI agents.

Just as my own "Grokbots" already hold team meetings twice a day, which I simply attend mostly as an observer. https://t.co/pL5PovMtvw

GOOGLE 🔥: Gemini 4 Neon reference has been spotted on Gemini web!

Would be cool if it would be a new Flash Lite model (pure speculation). Looks like Google isn’t done with new releases. 

* Not available yet 👀 https://t.co/dQMqv9PVMZ https://t.co/24FVLd08jS

NVIDIAs board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO. It's focused on its investigation into him and isn't in talks about a return, a source tells CNBC. https://t.co/9ddda5djB3 https://t.co/hyeJZP7oaI

OpenRouter ❤️ HuggingFace

HuggingFace switching its inference provider to OpenRouter!

Cybersecurity company Corma has raised $125M at a $1B valuation in a Series A led by NEA.

The company’s main product, Corma Cyber Defense, is a purpose-built foundation model for defensive cybersecurity, including threat detection, triage, investigation, and incident response. https://t.co/vPuX8ii7rD https://t.co/d64tucSmc3

August has launched “Instinct for Healthcare”, allowing August agent to call a doctor's office and book an appointment on behalf of a patient. 

August is an AI-powered health and wellness companion designed to help users interpret medical data, analyze symptoms, and navigate https://t.co/ibyX8gzfcm https://t.co/Ogb6Bky0J2

Just arrived in San Francisco to attend at @Microsoft Ignite. 

And look what was waiting right there for me in my Hotel room. That’s really super nice! Thank you so much, Microsoft! (Even a jacket with my name on it :) https://t.co/ECGW3s7eSj

It happened - Grok Bot is taking over the Sphere ad placement in Las Vegas.

A perfect "Product ad fit" 🔥 https://t.co/EUHJoaLxJj

Salesforce's own State of Sales report says the average rep spends 40% of the week selling.

Much of the other 60% is admin, and a good chunk of it is CRM data entry.

Dreamteam launched today with $53M to take that job away. It listens to calls, email, Slack and meetings and https://t.co/mJtq5LbCBa
